newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: CRICKET-SRI LANKA 102-4 VS NEW ZEALAND AT LUNCH.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SRI LANKA 102-4 VS NEW ZEALAND AT LUNCH.

text.p: Sri Lanka were 102 for the loss of four wickets at lunch on Monday in their second innings on the fourth day of the first cricket test against New Zealand.
New Zealand scored 586 in their first innings and enforced the follow-on after Sri Lanka were all out for 222 in reply.
New Zealand first innings 586 for seven declared (B. Young 267 not out).
Sri Lanka first innings 222 (S. Doull 5-58). Second innings 102 for four (S. Jayasuriya 50).
